sour_shackle.method: hand-authored on the 16x16 grid, third pass on 29 September 2026 after Elias's two reviews: the draft's big drop of sour light and its gold claws are back, the ring is hollow (transparent, with the outline running round the hole too), the outline closes above the gem and under the ring, and the band stays two texels thick at the sides; the piece stands 16 by 12. enves_shrine_plinth.method: hand-authored on the 16x16 grid by the authoring script; its model maps 1 texel per 1/16 unit
reference_inspected: entrelumen:textures/item/sour_light_shard.png (ours: the TIP, BODY and ROT ramps, art/authoring/draw_enves.py)
enves_shrine_plinth.reference_took: Respawn anchor: the whole state change is a glowing core turned dead, with the light level falling with it (here 13 to 2). Trial vault: active and spent read only by what glows, so nothing else changes. Enchanting table: a full-width dark base under a smaller ornament. White Wither: the ivory ribs and gold of the vessel that holds the sour light; the drop is that light.
enves_shrine_plinth.note: The shrine's plinth, top and sides in one four-fold grid (its border rows are the side bands); on top, rays point in to the spine, a sun turned inside out. Envés shrine (docs/design/dungeon-enves.md, «Arte propio de los bloques»). No third-party pixels copied.

enves_brazier_bell.reference_took: Soul campfire: fire as two crossed planes of animated flame in a cold colour, and only the flame and the embers change with the state. Ars Nouveau ritual brazier: the inside of the bowl glows when lit. Occultism sacrificial bowl: a bowl about 6 high on a 12 x 12 footprint, on feet, the proportions of the block's 12 x 7 x 12 shape. Vanilla bell: the flared lip, the sound bow and the crown's loops, here upside down (the loops became four feet).
enves_brazier_bell.note: Sides of the upturned bell by height: bronze feet and crown, the Wither's gold above, the sound bow brightest. Envés brazier (docs/design/dungeon-enves.md, «Arte propio de los bloques»). No third-party pixels copied.
